description: EU VAT number validation (batch) — Validate up to 10 EU VAT numbers in one call against the official VIES service: VALID / INVALID / BAD_FORMAT per number with the registered name and address when the member state publishes them, a batch verdict and a needs-review list. Spaces, dots and dashes are stripped. vats = comma-separated VAT numbers with country prefix. Price: $0.04 USDC (Base, via x402).
